text:
ATLANTA, GA - For parents and teachers searching for the perfect blend of storytelling, education, and engagement, Listen ‘n’ Learn Sound Stories by Ellen Hajek delivers a delightful surprise. This collection of 26 read-aloud stories—one for each letter of the alphabet—invites children into a vibrant world of characters, sounds, and fun, all while building the foundational skills they need for confident reading.
Aimed at kindergarten through second grade learners, the stories are brought to life through expressive narration and vibrant illustrations by Donita Milleson. Each tale is lovingly designed to emphasize a specific phonetic sound, helping children connect the dots between letters and language in a way that feels natural—and downright entertaining.
From “Too Many Pancakes!” (featuring Annie’s alphabetic adventures with breakfast) to “X Finds His Spot” (a tale of self-discovery and buried treasure), the collection offers more than just stories. Every story is a phonics playground, followed by guided questions and creative activities that reinforce literacy while sparking imagination.
Each narrative comes with lesson-aligned support, including:
-
Sound recognition games and movement exercises
-
Creative drawing and rhyming prompts
-
Opportunities for social-emotional learning, from empathy to curiosity
Whether used at home during story time or in the classroom as part of a phonics curriculum, Listen ‘n’ Learn Sound Stories is both a tool and a treat.
Get Your Copy Today
Listen ‘n’ Learn Sound Stories is now available in hardcover, paperback, and eBook formats on Amazon. Perfect for literacy programs, and homeschooling families. Grab your copy now, and turn every sound into a story worth remembering.
About the Author
Ellen Hajek is a dedicated educator, storyteller, and advocate for early childhood literacy. She combines pedagogical insight with narrative joy to make learning engaging for young minds. Her writing reflects her deep belief in the power of story as both an educational and emotional tool.
About Author’s Tranquility Press
Author’s Tranquility Press is a leading publishing and publicity firm based in Atlanta, Georgia, committed to amplifying the voices of authors with stories that inspire, teach, and uplift. Whether it’s fiction, faith-based writing, or educational material, ATP helps books find the readers they’re meant to reach.
